articles.summary: New York, NY (June 29, 2026) — Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s largest global financial groups, proudly announces a Japanese Operating Lease with Call Option (“JOLCO”) facility for Viva Aerobus (“Viva”), with Three i's Capital Co., Ltd. (“Three i’s Capital”). The transaction marks Viva’s first JOLCO and Three i's Capital’s first investment into an aircraft JOLCO.
articles.title: MUFG leads Viva Aerobus’s debut JOLCO

articles.summary: NEW YORK, June 8, 2026 – Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups, today announced its role in the successful financing of The Delfin LNG project’s first floating liquefied natural gas vessel, Delfin FLNG 1, a transformative energy infrastructure project under development in Louisiana and offshore in the Gulf of America.
articles.title: MUFG Announces $3.6 Billion Financing for Delfin LNG’s First Floating LNG Vessel

articles.summary: NEW YORK, NY (June 9, 2026) — Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the largest global financial groups, today announced the appointment of Prasad Uddaraju as the company’s first Chief Data & Artificial Intelligence Officer. Mr. Uddaraju brings more than two decades of experience modernizing enterprise data platforms, advancing analytics capabilities, and strengthening data governance across leading global financial institutions.
articles.title: MUFG Appoints Prasad Uddaraju as First Chief Data & Artificial Intelligence Officer
